opinions.point: Many commenters considered this the strongest episode so far, especially praising its intensity and payoff.
The animation was widely viewed as unusually strong, with several commenters highlighting the episode's fluid action and visual quality.
The central character interactions and comedic timing were popular, especially the chemistry and banter between the leads.
Some viewers enjoyed the story's inventive problem-solving, while others felt one deduction was too convenient or forced.
Many commenters approved of the ending credits being omitted, seeing it as beneficial to the episode's momentum; a smaller group was uncertain whether the change was permanent.
